name: Bangongshi Shushu
source:
You will come to a new city and start your new life.
You are a fresh employee and are curious about everything here.
Here, you will know a lot of friends.
Start your new life and at the same time...find your love.
Hurry up and date your uncles!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1728490/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你将来到一座全新的城市，开启崭新的人生。
作为一名初出茅庐的新员工，你对这里的一切都充满好奇。
在这里，你将结识许多朋友。
开启新生活的同时……寻觅属于你的爱情吧。
快去和办公室的叔叔们约会吧！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1728490/]Steam[/url]]
